_comment: NOT PART OF THE RST JAIPUR 2026 DATA-USE ROUND. This describes a session-feedback survey, which is a different instrument from the ARM1/ARM2 data-use experiment the repository ships. Do not submit it for that round - submitting freezes the wording forever. Use templates/data_use_demo_intro_en.json and templates/data_use_demo_close_en.json instead.
Entry point for the feedback survey, offering the two tracks.
The 2023 original (rst_feedbackintro) carries no year and is still
approved, so it could be reused as-is. It is recreated here only so that
the 2026 round has its own named template and the wording can say 2026
If there is no Innovation Fair in 2026, drop the second button and the
clause that mentions it - a template offering a track that does not exist
would strand anyone who taps it.
The button ids match the 2023 payloads so the existing Studio split widgets
